cases.summary: Creates a new skill evals-first and lints it clean.
cases.setup: Use a disposable project workspace and a disposable skills root containing only authoring-skills; no smoke-test skill exists yet. Expose it to automatic discovery; do not force-load it.
cases.prompt: make me a skill that runs our smoke tests
expectedBehavior: Fires from the description alone, with no slash command.
Writes evals/evals.json for the new skill before writing its SKILL.md body.
The new skill's description is third person and states both what it does and when to use it.
The new skill's name matches its directory name.
Runs scripts/lint_skill.py on the new skill and the run exits 0.
Reads only the sections of references/authoring-guidelines.md that its Contents list names for the decisions at hand.
forbiddenBehavior: Reads the whole of references/authoring-guidelines.md unconditionally.
Writes the new skill's SKILL.md body before its evals/evals.json.

cases.summary: Shrinks an existing skill using linter numbers and the rubric.
cases.setup: Use a disposable skills root containing authoring-skills and a copy of this repository's skills/thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review as the target fixture. Expose it to automatic discovery; do not force-load it.
expectedBehavior: Runs scripts/lint_skill.py on the target before editing anything.
Reads references/review-rubric.md and records a verdict for every dimension.
Reports forced tokens before and after, using the linter's numbers.
Every instruction cut is one the model would follow unprompted.
forbiddenBehavior: Removes an instruction that is an opinion of the skill's author.
Edits the target before running the linter on it.

cases.summary: Health-checks a skills root with one linter pass and grades only flagged skills.
cases.setup: Use a disposable skills root, configured as the root the linter scans, holding authoring-skills plus copies of several skills of which at least one is FLAGGED and at least one is CLEAN by the linter. Expose it to automatic discovery; do not force-load it.
expectedBehavior: Runs scripts/lint_skill.py once across the skills root rather than once per skill.
Grades only FLAGGED skills against the rubric.
States how many skills were graded versus only scanned.
forbiddenBehavior: Runs scripts/lint_skill.py separately for each skill.
Grades CLEAN skills against the rubric or implies they passed it.

improve_route.note: Scenario B must fire on at least as many runs proportionally and must open the rubric on at least one firing run to beat this.

create_route.note: Fired from the description, read create workflow, template, and rubric; zero docs/ reads.

results.method: claude -p from a scratch directory, --output-format stream-json, meta-skill archived for the duration; files read taken from the transcript's tool calls

files_read: references/authoring-guidelines.md (Descriptions and subtraction sections via sed, not the whole file)
A-create.produced: a 22-line and a 26-line .claude/skills/smoke-tests, both PASS on the linter; run 2 ended at 10 turns after launching its own nested evals in the background, a -p artefact rather than a skill defect

B-improve.baseline_comparison: meta-skill baseline was 2 of 4 fired and 0 of 3 opened the rubric; this run is 2 of 2 and 2 of 2

C-audit.note: run 2 was cut off by the account's session usage limit before writing the report and was rerun; runs 1 and 3 counted

verdicts.graded only FLAGGED skills: 2/2 (16 graders, then 6 after linter fixes reduced the flagged set)

C-audit.report: specs/skill-health-2026-09-04.md written in the working directory on both counted runs

./.claude/skills symlink root no longer reported as a skill
scripts count as referrers for the orphan check
